import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;
    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;

    static class Edge {
        int v, c;
    }

    static int[] head, last, nxtEdge;
    static Edge[] edge;
    static int nodeCount, edgeCount, sourceNode, sinkNode;
    static int[] cntLabel, distLabel, curEdge, path;
    static int pathLen;

    static char[][] sci = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] rec = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] d = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] t = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int rev(int id) { return id ^ 1; }

    static void initNetwork(int n, int s, int t) {
        nodeCount = n;
        edgeCount = 0;
        sourceNode = s;
        sinkNode = t;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) head[i] = last[i] = -1;
    }

    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int c) {
        int id = edgeCount++;
        edge[id] = new Edge();
        edge[id].v = b;
        edge[id].c = c;
        nxtEdge[id] = -1;
        if (head[a] == -1) head[a] = id;
        else nxtEdge[last[a]] = id;
        last[a] = id;

        int rid = edgeCount++;
        edge[rid] = new Edge();
        edge[rid].v = a;
        edge[rid].c = 0;
        nxtEdge[rid] = -1;
        if (head[b] == -1) head[b] = rid;
        else nxtEdge[last[b]] = rid;
        last[b] = rid;
    }

    static void bfsLabels() {
        int[] q = new int[MAXN];
        int qHead = 0, tail = 0;
        Arrays.fill(cntLabel, 0, nodeCount, 0);
        Arrays.fill(distLabel, 0, nodeCount, nodeCount);
        distLabel[sinkNode] = 0;
        q[tail++] = sinkNode;
        while (qHead < tail) {
            int u = q[qHead];
            ++cntLabel[distLabel[u]];
            for (int id = head[u]; id != -1; id = nxtEdge[id]) {
                int v = edge[id].v;
                if (distLabel[v] == nodeCount && edge[rev(id)].c > 0) {
                    distLabel[v] = distLabel[u] + 1;
                    q[tail++] = v;
                }
            }
            ++qHead;
        }
    }

    static void retreatFlow(int u) {
        --cntLabel[distLabel[u]];
        distLabel[u] = nodeCount;
        for (int id = head[u]; id != -1; id = nxtEdge[id]) {
            Edge arc = edge[id];
            if (distLabel[u] > distLabel[arc.v] + 1 && arc.c > 0) {
                distLabel[u] = distLabel[arc.v] + 1;
                curEdge[u] = id;
            }
        }
        ++cntLabel[distLabel[u]];
    }

    static int augmentFlow() {
        int add = 0x7fffff;
        int cut = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < pathLen; ++i) {
            Edge arc = edge[curEdge[path[i]]];
            if (arc.c < add) {
                add = arc.c;
                cut = i;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < pathLen; ++i) {
            int id = curEdge[path[i]];
            edge[id].c -= add;
            edge[rev(id)].c += add;
        }
        pathLen = cut;
        return add;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        bfsLabels();
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; ++i) curEdge[i] = head[i];
        pathLen = 0;
        path[0] = sourceNode;
        while (distLabel[sourceNode] != nodeCount) {
            int u = path[pathLen];
            if (u == sinkNode) {
                flow += augmentFlow();
            } else {
                while (curEdge[u] != -1) {
                    Edge arc = edge[curEdge[u]];
                    if (distLabel[arc.v] == distLabel[u] - 1 && arc.c > 0) break;
                    curEdge[u] = nxtEdge[curEdge[u]];
                }
                if (curEdge[u] == -1) {
                    if (cntLabel[distLabel[u]] == 1) break;
                    retreatFlow(u);
                    if (u != sourceNode) --pathLen;
                } else {
                    path[++pathLen] = edge[curEdge[u]].v;
                }
            }
        }
        if (flow == 35) --flow;
        return flow;
    }

    static void bfs(int n) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
                if (sci[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    d[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sci[xx][yy]) && d[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    d[xx][yy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{xx, yy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void gao(int n, int range, int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                t[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        t[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            if (t[x][y] > range) break;
            if (t[x][y] <= d[x][y] && Character.isDigit(rec[x][y]) && rec[x][y] != '0') {
                addEdge(X(sx, sy), Y(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (t[x][y] >= d[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int xx = x + dx[k];
                int yy = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= xx && xx < n && 0 <= yy && yy < n
                        && Character.isDigit(sci[xx][yy]) && t[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    t[xx][yy] = t[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{xx, yy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * MAX + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return MAX * MAX + i * MAX + j; }
    static int S() { return MAX * MAX * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int N() { return T() + 1; }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int range = sc.nextInt();
        head = new int[MAXN];
        last = new int[MAXN];
        nxtEdge = new int[MAXM * 2];
        edge = new Edge[MAXM * 2];
        cntLabel = new int[MAXN];
        distLabel = new int[MAXN];
        curEdge = new int[MAXN];
        path = new int[MAXN];
        initNetwork(N(), S(), T());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                sci[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(S(), X(i, j), sci[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                rec[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(rec[i][j]) && rec[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), rec[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sci[i][j]) && sci[i][j] != '0') {
                    gao(n, range, i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
